bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to parks and trails; appropriating money for the Root River State Trail.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ROOT RIVER STATE TRAIL; PRESTON TO CARIMONA; APPROPRIATION.

$6,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the parks and trails fund to the commissioner of natural resources for construction of the Root River State Trail under Minnesota Statutes, section 85.015, from the city of Preston to Carimona. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
